artworks.title: Puss in Boots, or General Junot taken by Surprise
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring a theatrical scene. One character is dressed in an elaborate costume, while another character appears surprised. The scene includes vibrant colors and detailed elements such as a hat resembling a bonnet and boots. The central character wears a large brimmed hat with a feather, a dress with a spotted pattern, tall boots, and a sword. Another character to the right wears a red cap and white attire, showing a startled expression. The backdrop consists of a green curtain with a yellow and purple valance, creating a theatrical atmosphere. There is a small animal, resembling a cat, near the central character's feet. The painting is in the style of James Gillray.

artworks.title: Rural Sports. Smock Racing
artworks.description: The image features a lively scene viewed from a slightly elevated angle, showing a bustling event on a grassy hillside. The horizon is high, with clusters of spectators in the distance. Detailed figures in a caricature style are shown in animated gestures and expressions. The color palette includes vibrant hues dominating the attire, with green shades for the hills and trees, and black and beige for contrast. A tented area with flags adds to the festive atmosphere, while dynamic postures and energetic crowd convey a sense of chaos, depicting a rural or carnival life scene.

artworks.title: Rural Sports or a Cricket Match Extraordinary
artworks.description: This is a painting of a cricket match on a grassy field. The figures are playing cricket in an exaggerated and cartoonish manner, characterized by their dynamic poses. In the background, there is a large tent with a flag that reads "The Lady Cricketers," and smoke rises from an industrial structure in the distance. Spectators are gathered around, observing the game with animated gestures. The figures are wearing colorful dresses. The overall tone is playful and captures a sense of excitement and chaos as the game unfolds. The style is reminiscent of Thomas Rowlandson, known for his satirical and caricature style.

artworks.title: Rural Sports. Cat in a Bowl. No.1
artworks.description: This is a painting of a rural scene with various humorous elements. The scene includes a cat in a floating bowl, ducks in water, people observing, a child with a dog, people running towards the water, a tumbling cart, and more onlookers. The setting is near a small lake or pond with green trees and a house in the background.

artworks.title: A French Dentist Shewing a Specimen of his Artificial Teeth and False Palates
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in close-up, focusing on their upper torsos and heads. The person on the left wears a blue coat and red waistcoat, with curly white hair, a gold hoop earring, a hooked nose, and a wide grin. The middle individual has exaggerated facial features, rosy cheeks, and is wearing a white cap with a pink ribbon and a yellow garment, touching their own face. The person on the right holds either gold pince-nez glasses or a dental tool, wearing a pink coat with a green collar, a bulbous nose, and an oversized mouth. The background has a light blue patterned backdrop and handwritten text near the top right corner.

artworks.title: Modern Antiques
artworks.description: This is a painting of a comedic and busy scene in an antiquities shop or museum. The image shows an eclectic collection of artifacts displayed, including a partially opened sarcophagus with a vibrant sarcophagus to its right. Various sculptures and busts surround the scene, depicting mythical or historical figures contributing to the antiquated setting. The shelves are packed with a variety of vases differing in size and design, referencing ancient artifacts from different cultures. At the bottom of the image are scrolls, statues, and smaller objects adding to the chaotic yet fascinating atmosphere. The style resembles that of Thomas Rowlandson, known for vivid, satirical depictions and bustling compositions filled with lively detail.

artworks.title: Ducking a Scold
artworks.description: There is a painting of a scene with a group of people surrounding a ducking chair apparatus. The central focus is the ducking stool, with a figure partially submerged in water. The figure's expression suggests displeasure. The onlookers are depicted with exaggerated expressions and gestures, adding action to the scene. The crowd wears colorful costumes and a small animal is balancing on a wooden bowl in the water. Architectural details in the background include visible windows with observers peeking out.

artworks.title: A Dog Fight
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a dog fight in a crowded indoor arena. The central focus is on two dogs engaged in combat in the center of a circular space, surrounded by spectators. The audience consists mostly of men, some gesturing or leaning forward, while others hold back additional dogs. There are people perched on beams overhead. The clothing suggests a historical setting. The painting is done in a detailed illustrative style reminiscent of Thomas Rowlandson, known for his satirical depictions of British life.

artworks.title: Patience in a Punt
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a small boat on water. Three men, each dressed differently, are inside the boat - one navigating at the front with a pole and two others seated, possibly fishing. A dog swims close to the boat. In the background, there are lush trees and textured clouds in the sky. The color palette is muted with earthy tones and pastels. Smoke from a pipe adds a playful touch, and two swans are seen swimming in the water.

artworks.title: Doctor Syntax, in the Middle of a Smoking HotPolitical Squabble, wishes to Wet his W histle
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene featuring a lively gathering in a tavern or public house setting. The room is filled with men and women engaged in various activities. A central figure is serving drinks, while patrons are dressed in historical costumes. Shelves stocked with kitchenware are visible, along with a clock on the wall and a sign underneath. Dogs are present, and smoke rises from a table near the hearth.

artworks.title: Bartholomew Fair
artworks.medium: etching and stipple with hand coloring on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to platemark): 24.5 × 35.7 cm (9 5/8 × 14 1/16 in.)
mount: 32.1 × 50.8 cm (12 5/8 × 20 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a fair scene with various activities and performances taking place in an open square. The scene is lively with many figures engaged in different forms of entertainment and social interaction. To the left, there is a grand building with ornate architectural details. The scene captures swings, shows and performances on stages, a diverse crowd, and vendors selling goods. The background shows a large church with tall spires, while the foreground includes details such as dogs and performers. The attire is colorful and detailed, creating a vivid and animated portrayal of a fairground scene. This painting is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.

artworks.title: Madame Very Restaurateur, Palais Royal Paris
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up. The person on the right is seated and facing the viewer, with an intricate updo hairstyle reflected in the mirror behind them. Their facial features are rounded with rosy cheeks, and they are wearing a white garment with puffy sleeves and lace details. The person on the left is in profile, looking towards the seated figure, with elongated and exaggerated facial features. This person has a tall, dark updo and wears a pink dress with a high neckline. Two baskets filled with French fries and paper strips are on the table in front of them, along with a plate of colorful round objects and a multicolored hat. There’s a large mirror on the wall, framed in ornate gold, and a candlestick is visible; a large potted plant with dense green foliage stands nearby. The setting appears to be indoors, with light-blue walls in the background.

artworks.title: La Belle Limonaudiere au Cafe des Mille Colonnes, Palais Royal, Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing an interior scene of a grand room. The room is adorned with classical architectural elements, ornate furniture, and decorative details. In the foreground, a person is seated at a table with a document marked "PARIS". The room is bustling with smaller figures engaged in conversation and activities. Classical sculptures are visible in the background.

artworks.title: Mr. Bullock's Exhibition of Laplanders
artworks.description: This is a painting of an exhibition of Lapland life. The artwork depicts scenes of Lapland life in a theatrical setting. Crowds are gathered on either side of the image, enclosed by walls decorated with furs and antlers. In the foreground, there are numerous reindeer, some adorned with colorful fabric. The middle ground features figures in fur garments, reminiscent of Laplanders, interacting. The backdrop displays a mural of an icy, mountainous landscape under a cloudy sky. The painting provides a glimpse into a historical exhibition that aimed to showcase foreign lifestyles. The artist skillfully blends detailed character portrayal with an elaborate stage-like setting.

artworks.title: Boney's Trial, Sentence, and Dying Speech
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. The image depicts various figures dressed in historical attire in a trial setting. A prominent figure is standing and addressing the court with a raised hand. Dignified individuals are observing from behind a barrier. A large panel with detailed writing is on the right side of the image, next to a figure seated next to a menacing character. The scene is satirical, showing expressions of indignation, curiosity, and judgment on the faces of the onlookers and participants in a richly decorated courtroom setting.

artworks.title: Saint John
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure on a throne-like chair, with one leg crossed over the other. One hand is holding a chalice while the other hand is raised with a pointed finger. The figure has curly hair, distinct facial features, and wears a long draped garment. The background includes columns, an arch, and detailed carvings of grapevines and leaves.

artworks.title: La Danseuse: A Study of the Nude
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a person's upper body and arms extended outward. The person is sketched in profile, with minimal facial features and short hair. The arms are holding up a piece of cloth or garment. The person's attire appears to be loose, possibly a robe. The sketch is on a light, textured background with no visible jewelry or objects. The backdrop is the textured surface of the paper or canvas.

artworks.title: The Fireplace
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure in an architectural setting. The figure is seated on a ledge or bench under an arch supported by columns. The architectural elements are depicted with lines and shading, suggesting a classical style with pillars and shadowed recesses. The figure is sketched with a few lines, capturing the pose and possibly a hat or headdress. The mood is tranquil, with a focus on light and shadow giving depth to the structure.

artworks.title: Staircase
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior space with a staircase, columns, and decorative elements. The hallway leads towards the staircase at the center. The staircase is detailed, and there are vertical lines from columns. Decorative elements are visible on the right, with circular and flowing lines suggesting artwork. The foreground has light floor tile patterns. The drawing is created with pencil strokes and plays with light and shadow.

artworks.title: Paris Diligence
artworks.medium: etching and stipple with hand coloring on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy street scene with a variety of interactions and figures. The perspective shows the street extending into the distance with buildings lining the horizon. The style is detailed with fine lines and colored with vibrant greens, reds, yellows, and blues contrasted against paler tones. There is a stagecoach with animated figures, animals, drivers in green uniforms with white horses, and more figures and buildings in the background. The scene conveys a sense of motion and activity.

artworks.title: Preparing to Start
artworks.description: The image depicts a horse racing event from an elevated viewpoint. The background shows a sloping horizon with hills and scattered trees. The sky has soft clouds against a light blue backdrop. The color scheme is vibrant with bright pastels and earthy tones. In the foreground, spectators and horseback riders gather around a platform where officials stand under a red roof. Further back, jockeys in colorful attire prepare for the race. Tents and stands in the distance indicate more spectators.

artworks.title: Dancer Seen from Behind and Three Studies of Feet
artworks.medium: black chalk and pastel on blue-gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Myron A. Hofer in memory of his mother,  Mrs. Charles Hofer

artworks.title: Le stryge (The Vampire)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Myron A. Hofer in memory of his mother,  Mrs. Charles Hofer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cityscape with a gargoyle. The gargoyle is perched on a ledge overlooking a densely populated city with various buildings and a tall cathedral in the background. Birds are seen flying above the city. The gargoyle has wings and a serious expression, emphasizing its overseeing role. The architecture suggests a historic style, possibly Gothic. The perspective creates depth, leading the eye from the foreground to the distant tower.

artworks.title: Two Lawyers
artworks.medium: crayon and stump with gray and orange wash on  laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Myron A. Hofer in memory of his mother,  Mrs. Charles Hofer
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing next to each other. Both have simplified facial features, angled towards each other. They are wearing head coverings, possibly caps or hats, and long robes or cloaks. The men stand with their feet pointing forward. In the background, there are blurred figures suggesting a bustling scene, possibly a marketplace or social gathering. The sketch is monochromatic with shades of brown and gray.
